note: v21 guard set: the ledger's known failure mode is an irrelevant quantity; this measures its harm.

rows.text: A custodian has to clean a school with 80 classrooms and 20 offices. They have 5 days to get it done. It takes them 15 minutes per classroom. If they work an 8-hour day, what percentage of their day, on average, is spent cleaning classrooms?

Jana has a mix of puppies and kittens. Two thirds of Jana's pets are puppies and the rest are kittens. Among the puppies, two thirds are Pomeranians and the rest are Labradors. One third of the Pomeranians are girls. If there are 6 Pomeranian girls, how many puppies does Jana have, regardless of the number of kittens or Labradors?

Emma is a dedicated vlogger who can make and upload 72 vlogs per month. In the first week of the month, she was busy with a charity event but still managed to make 18 vlogs. In the second week, she was able to increase her productivity despite a minor cold and made 21 vlogs. In the third week, she had to attend a family gathering, which took some of her time, but she still made 15 vlogs. Considering that she also spent 5 hours each week on a cooking class that doesn't affect her vlogging schedule, how many vlogs should she make in the fourth week to reach her monthly goal of 72 vlogs?

Emil is 19 years old now. He has an 8-year-old sister. When he turns 24, he will be half the age of his dad but twice as old as his brother.  What is the sum of the ages of his dad and his brother now?

Kelly is grocery shopping at a supermarket and is making sure she has enough in her budget for the items in her cart. She has 5 packs of bacon that cost $10 in total. She also picked up a magazine for $5, but she put it back on the shelf because she decided she didn't need it. She has 6 packets of chicken which each cost twice as much as a pack of bacon. She also has 3 packs of strawberries, priced at $4 each, and 7 packs of apples, each priced at half the price of a pack of strawberries. She also considered buying a $3 bottle of water, but decided against it. If Kelly’s budget is $65 then how much money, in dollars, does she have left in her budget?

Harold sleeps for 10 hours a night.  He works 2 hours less than he sleeps and he walks his dog for an hour each day, 20 minutes of which is spent playing frisbee with the dog.  How much free time does Harold have left in his day?

A mother goes shopping on a sunny day when the temperature is 75 degrees Fahrenheit. She buys cocoa at $4.20, laundry detergent at $9.45, and a package of pasta at $1.35. She also notices a beautiful dress priced at $50, but decides not to buy it. After paying with a $20 bill, how much change does the cashier give back?

Sunny is selling gingerbread and apple pie for a fundraiser. On Saturday, he sold 10 boxes of gingerbread and 4 fewer boxes of apple pie, than on Sunday. On Sunday, he sold 5 more boxes of gingerbread than on Saturday and 15 boxes of apple pie. In the end, gingerbread had 12 boxes left, and apple pie had 25 boxes left. If the gingerbread cost $6 and the apple pie cost $15, how much did Sunny earn for two days?
Jenna and her mother picked some apples from their apple farm. Jenna picked half as many apples as her mom. If her mom got 20 apples, which taks 30 minutes, how many apples did they both pick?

Matthew is working in a garden where the temperature is 75 degrees Fahrenheit and the wind speed is 5 mph. It takes him 3 minutes to dig a small hole for shrubs and 10 minutes to dig a large hole for trees, regardless of the weather conditions. If he has to dig 30 small holes for shrubs and 15 large holes for trees, how many hours will it take him to complete this task, assuming the weather conditions do not affect his digging speed?

There are four schools competing at a basketball tournament, which will last 5 days. Each school has sent a girls’ basketball team and a boys’ basketball team and each team has 5 players each. Each school has also sent a coach for each team. In total, how many people have all of the schools sent?

Milo is making a mosaic with chips of glass. It takes twelve glass chips to make every square inch of the mosaic. A bag of glass chips holds 72 chips. Milo wants his mosaic to be three inches tall. He also has a box of 50 unused chips from a previous project, but he decides not to use them for this mosaic. If he has two bags of glass chips, how many inches long can he make his mosaic?

John has decided to save money from his part-time job. He earns $2 per hour and works 5 hours a day for 4 days a week. He also spends $10 a week on transportation to and from work, but his parents have agreed to cover this cost for him. If his savings goal is $80, how many weeks will it take him to reach this amount?

It costs $194 per meter to repave a street. Monica's street is 150 meters long and it has 5 street lamps, each costing $20 to maintain, while Lewis' street is 490 meters long and has 15 street lamps, each also costing $20 to maintain. How much more does it cost to repave Lewis' street compared to Monica's, ignoring the cost of maintaining the street lamps?

John cuts down an 80-foot tree during a windy day with a wind speed of 15 mph. He can make logs out of 80% of it, despite the distracting wind. He cuts it into 4-foot logs, each weighing around 50 pounds. From each of those logs, he cuts 5 planks, each with a thickness of 2 inches. He then sells each plank for $1.2, even though the average market price is $1.5 per plank. How much does he make?

The Smith family is getting ready for summer and needs to have their swimming pool filled. The pool company instructed them to measure the volume of the pool and then multiply it by 5.9 to calculate how many gallons of water they needed. The cost for the pool company to come and fill the pool is $0.10 per gallon. Mr. Smith measured and found the pool was 14 feet wide, 25 feet long, and 4 feet deep. In addition, Mr. Smith had a $100 coupon for the pool company but found it expired. How much will it cost to fill the pool?

Tobias bought a big pizza with 60 pieces for $50. He ate 2/5 of the pieces on the first day, 10 pieces on the second day, and 7/13 of the remaining pieces on the third day. How many pizza pieces has he eaten so far?

20% of 50 people think horse #2 will win the big race, and two-fifths of them are girls.  60% of the remaining people think horse #7 will win.  The rest of the people think horse #12 will win the big race.  How many people think that horse #12 will win?

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field, and each hectare can produce 100 pineapples. He also has a mango field of 5 hectares, but the mangoes are not ready for harvest yet. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months, while the mangoes take 6 months to mature. Ignoring the mango field, how many pineapples can John harvest from his pineapple field within a year?

Sally received the following scores on her math quizzes: 50, 80, 80, 60, 40, 90, 100, 70, and 60. In the same period, she also participated in a series of unrelated art competitions, where she scored: 85, 90, 95, 100, 80, 75, 70, 95, and 90. Despite the art scores, we are only interested in her math performance. Find her mean score for the math quizzes.

John drives to his friend's house 200 miles away.  He drives at a speed of 70 mph. On the way, he comes across a car traveling at 90 miles per hour and almost gets into a traffic accident. He had to take a detour that added 10 miles to his trip.  After he gets there he takes a route home that is 240 miles but he goes 80 mph.  How long did the trip take?

Fred was preparing for a party to be held in four days. On the first day, he made 24 gallons of root beer and put them in the refrigerator cooler. That evening, his children discovered the root beer and drank 4 gallons. On the second day, his wife Barbie found the root beer and accidentally spilled 7 gallons. Meanwhile, Fred's neighbor, who was watering his garden, used 10 gallons of water, which has no impact on the root beer situation. On the third day, Fred's friend Ronnie visited and helped himself to the root beer, reducing the amount remaining by 5 gallons. On the same day, Fred's children played a game and scored 15 points, which doesn't affect the root beer quantity. On the fourth day, 3 people showed up for the party. If Fred and the others shared the remaining root beer equally, how much was available for each to drink during the party?

Toby is reading a book that is 45 pages long. Each page averages 200 words. Toby can read at a rate of 300 words per minute. He has to be at the airport in 60 minutes and plans to leave as soon as he finishes the book. It takes 10 minutes to get to the airport. Toby also has a habit of taking a 2-minute break after every 15 minutes of reading, but he has decided not to take any breaks today. Additionally, he has a sandwich next to him that takes 5 minutes to eat, but he chooses not to eat it until he gets to the airport. How many minutes early will Toby be?

In a basketball game, Bahati, Azibo, and Dinar were the only players who scored for their team, which earned a total of 45 points. Bahati, who was wearing jersey number 23, scored the most points. His score was 20 more than Azibo, who was wearing jersey number 11, and 10 more than Dinar, who was wearing jersey number 7. Despite the jersey numbers, how many points did Azibo score in the game?

Imma has 3 cats and a parrot. She feeds her cats twice a day with 60 grams of cat food and her parrot once a day with 10 grams of bird food. If she only has 720 grams of cat food and 200 grams of bird food, how many days will the cat food last?

Robyn sends sixteen emails a day. Seven of these emails are work-related, and she also sends five emails about her favorite TV show to a fan club, which she doesn't count in her daily total. After subtracting her work emails from her total, two-thirds of the remainder are to family. She also sends three emails to her local grocery store for a cooking recipe, which she also doesn't count in her daily total. One-third of the remaining emails, after accounting for work and family, are to her boyfriend. How many emails a day does she send to her boyfriend?

Mason is on his bike journey at a rate of 8 miles per hour. He travels for 4 hours, takes some rest, then goes on for another 6 hours, and then takes a break for two hours. How many miles has he traveled in total?

Sandy and Joey are participating in a weight loss challenge. Sandy wants to lose as much weight as Joey does but needs 4 weeks to lose the same amount of weight that Joey loses in a single week. Joey, who also spends 3 hours a week playing basketball, loses 8 pounds in 4 weeks. If Sandy spends the same amount of time playing basketball but it doesn't affect her weight loss rate, how many weeks will it take Sandy to lose the same amount of weight as Joey?

Jackie is trying to decide whether to do her taxes herself or hire an accountant. If she does the taxes herself, she'll be able to do 3 fewer hours of freelance work, losing $35/hour in missed income. The accountant charges $90. However, she also has a side hobby of painting, where she sells each painting for $50. She has 5 paintings ready to sell, but this will not affect her decision about the taxes. How much more money will she have if she hires the accountant?

The combined age of Peter, Paul, and Jean is 100 years old. Peter has a 20-year-old son. Find the age of Peter knowing that Paul is 10 years older than John and that Peter’s age is equal to the sum of Paul's and John's ages.

Ducks need to eat 3.5 pounds of insects each week to survive. There is a flock of ten ducks. Consider that each duck also consumes 0.5 pounds of grass daily, which is available in abundance and does not affect the amount of insects they need to eat. How many pounds of insects does the flock need to consume daily to survive?

Pierson scored 278 points in one game of bowling. Nikita scored 11 more than half as many as Pierson. Mike scored 8 less than twice as many as Nikita. How many points did Pierson and Nikita have in total?

Brook Hills High School currently enrolls 3000 students. Half of these students are over 16 years old, and one-fourth of the students over 16 years old are male. The remaining half of the students are under 16 years old, and one-half of the students under 16 are male. In addition, girls with long hair make up one third of the total number of girls In total, how many female students are enrolled at this school?

The recent floods in Mamou’s country have left many families without food or shelter. To help, Mamou has volunteered to distribute 1,360 meals to the affected families. She gave out 64 meals on Friday, and it taks 2 hours, 30 meals on Saturday, and 48 meals on Sunday. How many meals does she have left to distribute?

John is on a diet where he eats 200 grams of mushrooms every day, which are known to weigh 100 grams per cup and contain 3 grams of protein. He also drinks 2 liters of water daily and walks 5 kilometers every morning. Given this, how many grams of protein does John consume from the mushrooms in a week?

Diane gave a number train a starting value of 20. She then added a red herring value of 15, which she later subtracted, leaving the starting value unchanged. This starting value plus half the number was divided by 5, after which she added a distracting value of 10, but then subtracted it again. The resulting value was multiplied by the starting value minus 12, plus an irrelevant value of 7, which was then subtracted. What was the final value of the number train?

A water tank is filled with 120 liters of water. Celine used 90 liters of water from the tank to water her small garden. Then, it rained for three hours. She was then able to collect rainwater that was twice as much as what was left. How many liters of water are in the tank now?

After a long football practice, Bryce and four of his friends decided to order their own pizzas. Each pizza had 12 slices. Bryce and two of his friends, who were wearing red jerseys, ate 2/3 of their pizzas. The two remaining friends, who were wearing blue jerseys and had run an extra mile during practice, ate ¾ of their pizzas. Despite the different jerseys and the extra mile run, how many slices of pizza were left?

Dolly has two books, one of which is 300 pages long and the other is 250 pages long. Pandora has one book that is 200 pages long. If both Dolly and Pandora read each others' books as well as their own, regardless of the number of pages in each book, how many books will they collectively read by the end?

Helena is a mad scientist testing her latest creation, the Lots-of-Limbs Serum. The serum will make the drinker grow an extra arm every three days, an extra leg every five days, and 50 hairs every ten days. After fifteen days, how many new limbs will Helena’s serum cause a person to grow if they drink it?
